Cabin

Toboggan armé

A condition in which an aircraft's emergency evacuation slide is mechanically engaged to deploy automatically upon door opening.

Quick answer: A condition in which an aircraft's emergency evacuation slide is mechanically engaged to deploy automatically upon door opening.

Questions and answers

What is Toboggan armé?

In this glossary, Toboggan armé refers to: A condition in which an aircraft's emergency evacuation slide is mechanically engaged to deploy automatically upon door opening.

How is Toboggan armé used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Les toboggans des portes gauche et droite sont armés; la cabine est prête pour le roulage."

Definition

A condition in which an aircraft's emergency evacuation slide is mechanically engaged to deploy automatically upon door opening.

Operational example

Left and right door slides are armed; cabin is ready for taxi.

Localized term

Toboggan armé

Localized example

Les toboggans des portes gauche et droite sont armés; la cabine est prête pour le roulage.
